prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE complete full-body pixel sprite. Copy the WHOLE-BODY POSE from image 1, and clothe that exact pose with the Ultraman Arc Luna Armor identity from image 2. Image 1 is a pose guide only, never a finished skeleton character. Image 2 is the same accepted Luna character whose exact armor, head, silver-red suit and proportions must be kept.
The sprite faces SCREEN RIGHT in fixed side view. This is the FAR FOOT CONTACT phase of a walk. The WHITE/NEAR leg in image 1 is the leg CLOSER to the camera: its hip, knee, ankle and boot form the complete LEFT/BACK leg. Paint that whole BACK leg BRIGHT SILVER. The DARK/FAR leg in image 1 is the leg BEHIND the body in depth: its hip, knee, ankle and boot form the complete RIGHT/FRONT leg. Paint that whole FRONT leg DARK SILVER. Preserve these exact chains. The bright boot is LEFT of the hips; the dark boot is RIGHT of the hips. Both soles touch one ground line.
The near bright thigh visibly travels down-left to the rear knee, the far dark thigh visibly travels down-right to the leading knee. Keep a small heel-contact stride, torso upright, shoulder/hip counter-motion, fists in a natural walking guard. Arms and leg identities remain fixed. Whole person and all armor rendered together as one new frame.
Luna identity from image 2: swept low silver head crest and opening, yellow eye, bright cyan chest lamp, blue moon-shaped chest/shoulder armor, round cyan wrist armor, continuous red-and-silver suit. Same body size and natural limb lengths. Crisp arcade pixel clusters, stepped dark edges, limited 32-color shading, upper-left lighting.
True RGBA transparency. Full head, both boots, shoulder points and both wrist guards safely inside the picture. Continuous natural suit joints, original armor segmentation. One person only; clear background. No text, guide marks, skeleton, grid, shadow, weapon, glow or FX. No part cutting, rotating, body-piece replacement or mirroring.
